subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) He was awarded Bir Sreshtho which is the highest recognition of bravery in Bangladesh. (b) Rouf had to stop his education at his eight grade. (c) He was born on 1 May 1943 at Salampur village in Faridpur district. (d) He embraced martyrdom on 18 April 1971 at Kurighat after causing extensive deanger to Pakistani Army. (e) Munshi Abdur Rouf was Lance Nayek in East Pakistan Rifles during the Liberation War of Bangladesh. (f) He enlisted himself in East Bengal Regiment in that year. (g) He joined the East Pakistan Rifles on 8 May 1969. (h) He was buried at Nairchor upazilla in Rangamati district. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (e) + (c) + (b) + (g) + (f) + (d) + (h) + (a) Section B : Writing Test
